<thought>We need to retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 nitride compositions, consolidate them, prepare a tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, train an XGBoost model using the provided hyperparameters, evaluate it on the test set, perform 5‑fold cross‑validation, and finally write a JSON file containing the required evaluation results. The first step is to retrieve the polymorphs for a representative set of nitride formulas.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiN","VN","ZrN","HfN","CrN","MoN","NbN","TaN","AlN","GaN",
        "InN","Si3N4","BN","SiN","Mg3N2","Ca3N2","Sr3N2","Ba3N2",
        "ScN","Y3N5","LaN","CeN","PrN","NdN","SmN","GdN","DyN",
        "ErN","TmN","YbN","LuN","FeN","CoN","NiN","CuN","ZnN",
        "PbN","SnN","BiN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "nitrides_data"
}</action_input>
